craft_notes: Sthāyin: praise of the Veda-bodied. Device: comma→dash hold line 1 (hymning held), end-dash→comma (abiding released). Vṛtti ājñā-variant recorded in argmap, not imported. Rejected: smoothing śukrataḥ into 'light' plain — kept bright (Vṛtti: vedatraya-para). Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: Thee hymn we — sung in verse and chant, from splendour, past splendour, uttermost,
whose text-fleshed truth abides — ah, sombre-fair.
l4.sanskrit_cite: stumas tvām ṛgyajuḥsāmnāṃ śukrataḥ parataḥ param yasya vedātmikājñeyam aho gambhīrasundarī

reads_against.argmap: We praise you — of Ṛk-Yajus-Sāman, from bright, from beyond, beyond.; Whose Veda-embodied knowable — ah, deep-lovely. → Praise you beyond Veda, bright, beyond — deep-lovely knowable.
c1_essence: Law, start, close of worlds; duties march from none else.
reads_against.l2: You we laud — sung in verse, formula, chant, from light, from farther, farthest — your lore-body to be known — ah, sombre and fair.
l3: Thee hymn we — sung in verse and chant, from splendour, past splendour, uttermost —
whose text-fleshed truth abides — ah, sombre-fair.
